jobs.purpose: 24-frame evaluation of the same-family package (only after the 15 C256 WO blocks are individually packed the same way and J2 passes)

expected.report: per-frame PSNR, pooled RMSE, worst frame, RGB split, spatial difference and history behaviour - not a single mean
